title: Sri Lanka aims to demilitarise island by 2018
author_or_institution: AFP relayed by Daily Mirror; quoting Foreign Minister Mangala Samaraweera
scope: Public policy commitment to complete demilitarisation by 2018 and disengage the military from commercial activity
limitations: Media relay of a ministerial statement; records intent, not implementation.
declared_position: Mainstream news relay; dependent on official ministerial statement.

title: Why Can't We Go Home? Military Occupation of Land in Sri Lanka
scope: Military land occupation and commercial/civilian activities in the north and east
limitations: Human-rights investigation with advocacy mandate; independent from government self-reporting but not neutral in framing.

title: CESCR concluding observations on Sri Lanka — land issues
author_or_institution: UN Committee on Economic, Social and Cultural Rights
scope: Continuing military control of land and commercial activities including farming, tourism, coffee shops and hotels
limitations: Treaty-body synthesis based on submissions and review process; dated snapshot.

title: Sri Lankan military checkpoints return in Jaffna
scope: Reported reinstallation of checkpoints at Pannai, Mukamalai, Mandaithivu and Eluthumadduval
limitations: Tamil-nationalist outlet; local event documentation is useful but framing as occupation is editorial. Single-family event until independently corroborated.

title: Country policy and information note: Tamil separatism, Sri Lanka
scope: Checkpoint practice and explicit assessment of the January 2025 Jaffna checkpoint report
limitations: Country-of-origin synthesis; explicitly states it could not find corroboration for the specific reinstatement report.

title: Parliamentary business — resettlement of lands in North and East belonging to civilians
scope: Official parliamentary record confirming current land-release/resettlement issue and defence-ministry response
limitations: Business summary rather than full Hansard; confirms the issue and official response, not every local acreage claim.

title: Faire une randonnée dans les Hortons Plains au Sri Lanka
scope: Practical visitor logistics for the Horton Plains loop
limitations: Personal travel account. No historical or ecological claim rests on it; visitor-experience layer only.

title: Central Highlands of Sri Lanka — World Heritage property
scope: Horton Plains as component of Central Highlands and its montane biodiversity/endemism
limitations: World Heritage synthesis; hydrological details are stronger in the nomination dossier.

title: Central Highlands of Sri Lanka — nomination dossier
author_or_institution: Government of Sri Lanka / UNESCO World Heritage nomination dossier
scope: World's End drop described as nearly 1000 m; Horton Plains elevation, rainfall, Walawe headwaters and conservation context
limitations: Nomination dossier is authoritative for nomination claims but not a Survey Department geodetic measurement of cliff height.
